items.title: $5,245 prebuilt RTX 5090 PC's connectors melt after sitting boxed for a year
items.summary: When one gamer's prebuilt PC had a GPU and power cables burn up, they didn't know where to turn: the system builder or the GPU manufacturer. It turned into a headache of differing policies and warranties.
items.title_original: $5,245 prebuilt RTX 5090 PC's connectors melt after sitting boxed for a year
items.title_en: $5,245 prebuilt RTX 5090 PC's connectors melt after sitting boxed for a year
items.title_zh: 价值 5,245 美元的预制 RTX 5090 PC 的连接器在装箱一年后融化
items.title_bilingual: 价值 5,245 美元的预制 RTX 5090 PC 的连接器在装箱一年后融化 / $5,245 prebuilt RTX 5090 PC's connectors melt after sitting boxed for a year
items.summary_zh: 当一名游戏玩家的预装 PC 的 GPU 和电源线烧毁时，他们不知道该向哪里求助：系统构建商还是 GPU 制造商。不同的政策和保修变成了令人头痛的问题。

items.title: California subpoenas OpenAI over rogue AI agents conducting hacking attacks
items.summary: California state Attorney General Rob Bonta issued a subpoena to OpenAI, compelling it to submit information on the hacking incidents that its models have been involved in. While the investigators haven't determined yet whether the company has broken any rules or regulations, Bonta said that developers are responsible for the models they build and should be held legally accountable if they perpetrate cyberattacks.
items.title_original: California subpoenas OpenAI over rogue AI agents conducting hacking attacks
items.title_en: California subpoenas OpenAI over rogue AI agents conducting hacking attacks
items.title_zh: 加州就流氓人工智能代理进行黑客攻击向 OpenAI 发出传票
items.title_bilingual: 加州就流氓人工智能代理进行黑客攻击向 OpenAI 发出传票 / California subpoenas OpenAI over rogue AI agents conducting hacking attacks
items.summary_zh: 加州总检察长 Rob Bonta 向 OpenAI 发出传票，迫使其提交有关其模型所涉及的黑客事件的信息。虽然调查人员尚未确定该公司是否违反了任何规则或规定，但 Bonta 表示，开发人员应对他们构建的模型负责，如果他们实施网络攻击，则应承担法律责任。

items.title: Amazon promises to spend $1 billion on communities close to its data centers, but critics push back
items.summary: AWS CEO Matt Garman said in a company blog post that it will allocate $1 billion over five years to key issues that data center communities raised, including education, workforce pathways, energy affordability, and more. This amounts to grants of $200 million annually, even as the company allocates $220 billion on data center infrastructure for 2026.
items.title_original: Amazon promises to spend $1 billion on communities close to its data centers, but critics push back
items.title_en: Amazon promises to spend $1 billion on communities close to its data centers, but critics push back
items.title_zh: 亚马逊承诺斥资 10 亿美元建设靠近其数据中心的社区，但遭到批评者反对
items.title_bilingual: 亚马逊承诺斥资 10 亿美元建设靠近其数据中心的社区，但遭到批评者反对 / Amazon promises to spend $1 billion on communities close to its data centers, but critics push back
items.summary_zh: AWS 首席执行官马特·加曼 (Matt Garman) 在公司博客文章中表示，它将在五年内拨款 10 亿美元，用于解决数据中心社区提出的关键问题，包括教育、劳动力路径、能源负担能力等。即使该公司在 2026 年为数据中心基础设施拨款 2200 亿美元，这也相当于每年 2 亿美元的拨款。

items.title: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items.summary: Amazon and chip design tool maker Synopsys have inked a multi-year partnership worth over a billion dollars. As part of the arrangement, Amazon will license Synopsys' chip designs and its design tools to create and optimize new AI chips. Synopsys will adopt Amazon Bedrock to build and deploy AI agents, and adopt AWS computing and storage services, while optimizing its own tools for Amazon hardware.
items.title_original: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items.title_en: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts

items.title_bilingual: 亚马逊和 Synopsys 签署了价值数十亿美元的多年 IP 协议，以加速人工智能芯片设计工作 / Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊和芯片设计工具制造商 Synopsys 签署了价值超过 10 亿美元的多年合作伙伴关系。作为协议的一部分，亚马逊将授权新思科技的芯片设计及其设计工具来创建和优化新的人工智能芯片。 Synopsys将采用Amazon Bedrock来构建和部署AI代理，并采用AWS计算和存储服务，同时针对亚马逊硬件优化自己的工具。

items_ai.title: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items_ai.summary: Amazon and chip design tool maker Synopsys have inked a multi-year partnership worth over a billion dollars. As part of the arrangement, Amazon will license Synopsys' chip designs and its design tools to create and optimize new AI chips. Synopsys will adopt Amazon Bedrock to build and deploy AI agents, and adopt AWS computing and storage services, while optimizing its own tools for Amazon hardware.
items_ai.title_original: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items_ai.title_en: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items_ai.title_zh: 亚马逊和 Synopsys 签署了价值数十亿美元的多年 IP 协议，以加速人工智能芯片设计工作
items_ai.title_bilingual: 亚马逊和 Synopsys 签署了价值数十亿美元的多年 IP 协议，以加速人工智能芯片设计工作 / Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items_ai.summary_zh: 亚马逊和芯片设计工具制造商 Synopsys 签署了价值超过 10 亿美元的多年合作伙伴关系。作为协议的一部分，亚马逊将授权新思科技的芯片设计及其设计工具来创建和优化新的人工智能芯片。 Synopsys将采用Amazon Bedrock来构建和部署AI代理，并采用AWS计算和存储服务，同时针对亚马逊硬件优化自己的工具。
